proposals.value: The race's competitive axes have settled: platforms own the default entry point (clusters 2-6, 58, 59), infrastructure owns the physical ceiling (clusters 7-9, 69, 71), and economics asks whether either can hold surplus as models commoditize (clusters 10-12, 74). Capability is now table stakes (clusters 1, 56, 107), while a fast-maturing human-impact lens (clusters 77-83) is becoming the scoreboard on which platform and infrastructure claims will be judged.
